GitHub #403's fifth design (mitcad#1954; opened with --open, never committed; tools/cli/fillet-exact-reported-test.cmake): the fourth design's stepped block and Fillet1 (F12, radius d5 = 5) with the inner edge between the lower top and the step's wall rounded too. The corners at both ends of the front's top edge meet in its middle, and the inner edge would leave a rounding of its own at the core's corner inside the step, then (mitcad#1954) refused in words (before: built 0.1 % smaller with its warning and slivers). Now (GitHub #375, mitcad#2068) the ball rolls between the roundings of the lower top and the wall, the core's inner corner closed by a disc of 10: built, no warning, no face under 0.01 mm2, the volume (625 pi - 500) / 3 + 21.2367565 (geometry.suite.dressup_takes_face). At 2.4 the roundings do not meet: built by the kernel, no warning, no face under 0.01 mm2.
